country: Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Poland, Czech Republic

links.outcome: MI3 versus ESC 0/1h-algorithm sensitivity, NPV, specificity, PPV, rule-out and rule-in efficacy for type 1 NSTEMI
links.effect: ESC 0/1h had higher sensitivity (diff 0.88%, p=0.0082) and NPV (0.18%, p=0.016); MI3 had higher specificity (3.80%), PPV (7.84%) and rule-out efficacy (11%); ESC had higher rule-in efficacy (5.4%).
links.quote: The sensitivity and NPV of the ESC 0/1h-algorithm were higher than that of MI 3 (difference for sensitivity 0·88% [0·19 to 1·60], p=0·0082; difference for NPV 0·18% [0·05 to 0·32], p=0·016), and the rule-out efficacy was higher for MI 3 (11% difference, p<0·0001).

screen.reason: This is an external validation cohort study of a machine learning algorithm (MI3) for early diagnosis of myocardial infarction compared to standard ESC guidelines, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
